calls.note: Initial classification: three dolls, two rings and two pens replace the historical objects. Plan dolls in white, rings in blue and pens in red; localize the clearly visible left doll before the first left-arm grasp.
First-grasp approach: the localized doll lies face-up. Raise and incline the left tool toward the tabletop, preserving the historical downward approach; stop above the torso for wrist inspection.
The first approach was rejected without motion. Subdivide the same upward approach and inclination into smaller increments to respect joint continuity.

Recovery grasp check: the pads now bracket the head and tracking has recovered. Make a small vertical lift to verify retention.
The head also slipped backward out of the inclined jaws. Revise to a steeper downward grasp over the head center to reduce lateral pushing; reopen and align above it before descending.
The orientation segment was rejected after reopening. Subdivide the same steeper-downward approach; the doll shifted during release, so realign laterally above its new head position.
The doll rolled as the jaws cleared it. Re-localize the visible crown with the vertical tool established before the next descent.

The doll remains fixed between the pads through the test lift. Continue vertically to rim clearance, then begin the first transfer toward white.
